user_prompt: Write a concise reply disputing my landlord's $75 late fee. Point to the grace period in Section 4.2 and say the payment was on time. Respectful but firm, no apologizing, no more than 120 words.
final_prompt:
Write a concise reply disputing my landlord's $75 late fee. Point to the grace period in Section 4.2 and say the payment was on time. Respectful but firm, no apologizing, no more than 120 words.

<document>
From: Dana Whitfield, Maple Court Apartments
Subject: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi,

Our records show this month's rent was received on the 3rd. As you know, rent is due
on the 1st, so a late fee of $75 has been added to your account. We were disappointed
to see this, since on-time payments help us keep the building running for everyone.
We'd appreciate it if you could be more careful going forward. Please pay the fee
along with next month's rent.

Thanks for understanding,
Dana

---
Lease excerpt (Maple Court residential lease):
Section 4.1: Rent is $1,450 per month, payable by check, money order, or the resident
portal.
Section 4.2: Rent is due on the 1st. A grace period applies through the 5th; no late
fees may be charged during the grace period.
Section 4.3: Returned payments incur a $35 fee.
Section 9.4: Notices to the landlord must be in writing and may be sent by email.
</document>

baseline_runs.answer:
Subject: Re: Late fee - Unit 3B

Hi Dana,

Thank you for your message. I'm writing to dispute the $75 late fee applied to my account for this month's rent.

Section 4.2 of our lease provides a grace period through the 5th of the month, and states that no late fees may be charged during that period. My rent payment was received on the 3rd, which falls within the grace period. Because the payment was timely under the lease, the fee does not apply.

Please remove the $75 late fee from my account and confirm in writing once this has been done. I'm happy to provide proof of the payment date if needed.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,
[Your name]
Unit 3B
